answer: Model each agent as a vertex in a network exchanging canyon maps and glacier forecasts. Before processing any request, demand a memory-hard proof bound to its payload, key, expiry and a fresh nonce; record that nonce as spent. Do not grant free requests for registering another vertex. Renaming the sender cannot reuse the proof, so a Sybil swarm needs more computing hardware and electricity for every extra request. The verifier must be cheap, and puzzle difficulty must make the cheapest attack cost exceed the value of abusing a request.
